abstract: We report on a case of anti-N-Methyl-D-Aspartate receptor antibody encephalitis, and review cases and series previously published in the literature. Anti-N-Methyl-D-Aspartate receptor antibody encephalitis usually occurs in young female patients with no past medical history, in whom an ovarian teratoma is often detected. They subacutely develop predominantly psychiatric symptoms, followed by severe neurological disorders requiring transfer to the intensive care unit and prolonged ventilatory support. Complete or substantial recovery depends on early diagnosis, removal of the teratoma and immunotherapy. Our purpose is to focus intensivists' attention on this potentially lethal disorder, which should always be considered in young women admitted to the intensive care unit with characteristic neuropsychiatric disorders.
abstract_ja: 抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸(NMDA)受容体抗体脳炎の1例を報告し、既に文献で報告された症例とシリーズをレビューした。抗NMDA受容体抗体脳炎は通常、既往歴のない若年女性に発生し、卵巣奇形腫が検出されることが多い。亜急性に主に精神症状を発症し、その後、集中治療室への転送と長期の人工呼吸管理を要する重篤な神経障害が続く。完全または十分な回復は、早期診断、奇形腫の摘出、免疫療法に依存する。本稿の目的は、集中治療医の注意をこの生命を脅かしうる疾患に向けさせることであり、特徴的な神経精神障害で集中治療室に入院する若年女性では常に本疾患を考慮すべきである。
